reason: The named characters in this Exodus 12 passage are: (1) Moses (מֹשֶׁה), who receives God's command and leads the Israelites; (2) Aaron (אַהֲרֹן), who is called alongside Moses and serves as a co-leader; and (3) God (יְהוָה), who commands and directs the exodus. All other individuals mentioned—the people of Israel (בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל), Egyptians, sojourners (גֵּר), slaves (עֶבֶד), residents (תּוֹשָׁב), and hired servants (שָׂכִֽיר)—are referenced generically or collectively without individual names. Every named character identified in the text occupies a position of leadership or supreme authority.
